query: What are the consequences of sending threatening text messages?
reference_answer:
Threatening Text Messages:
Sending threatening text messages can result in imprisonment up to 3 years and/or a fine, under Section 506 of the IPC and the Information Technology Act, 2000.
answer: Sending threatening text messages can lead to legal consequences including fines and imprisonment. It also violates laws against harassment and could result in damage to relationships. [System]
